raw_response: {"diagnosis":"On 2026-01-18 the source changed how reversals are sent. Reversals now arrive as separate REVERSAL rows, and the original stays POSTED instead of being flipped to REVERSED. The silver filter on status='POSTED' therefore keeps the reversed originals and overstates totals. The fix excludes POSTED originals that a REVERSAL row points to, which matches the old behaviour where REVERSED originals were dropped.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id)"}}
